## Data sources

Data from the [Item Response Warehouse](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org) (each table name links to its IRW page); references from IRW biblio.

- [`verbagg`](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/tables/verbagg/): De Boeck and Wilson (2004), Explanatory Item Response Models, Springer. <https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4757-3990-9>. Licence: GPL-3.0.
- [`manolika_2021_mini_ipip`](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/tables/manolika_2021_mini_ipip/): Manolika, M. (2021). The Big Five and Beyond: Which Personality Traits Do Predict Movie and Reading Preferences? [Data set]. Harvard Dataverse. <https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/23NDKX>. Licence: CC0 1.0.
- [`rr98_accuracy`](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/tables/rr98_accuracy/): Ratcliff, R., & Rouder, J. N. (1998). Modeling Response Times for Two-Choice Decisions. Psychological Science, 9(5), 347-356. <http://doi.org/10.1111/1467-9280.00067>. Licence: GPL-3.0.
